environment.description: Django REST service deployed on ECS Fargate behind an AWS Application Load Balancer with default security group allowing 0.0.0.0/0 on port 443. ALB target group health check on /health. No IP-based restrictions configured. Authentication is via JWT tokens issued by Cognito user pool with self-registration enabled (any user can sign up and obtain a valid token). Service runs in us-east-1 VPC with public subnets.
